assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original illustrated campaign-logo emblem for the Home card of Guild of Wits, a medieval fantasy deduction game.
Primary request: design a distinctive self-contained emblem for “Four hidden formations”, the four daily deduction quests. The title is context only and MUST NOT appear as lettering in the image.
Subject: exactly four small ivory parchment formation cards fanned in a balanced heraldic arrangement, held together at the base by an antique-gold clasp with a simple guiding star. Each card has a few bold inset formation stones arranged in orderly rows, with dark-blue fields and warm brass outlines. A short deep-blue cloth ribbon with a restrained dotted silver medieval trim wraps the base; the ribbon is blank.
Style: polished hand-painted fantasy game key art distilled into a strong recognizable campaign logo, tactile parchment, engraved antique brass, crisp silhouette, generous large shapes, controlled detail. Sophisticated tabletop-guild identity, charming rather than grim. No character portraits.
Palette: warm ivory parchment, walnut-brown engraved shadows, antique gold, deep heraldic blue #285371; subtle highlights. Distinctive on both pale parchment and dark brown panels.
Composition: one centered emblem, roughly as wide as tall, all four card silhouettes clearly countable, every outer edge fully inside the image with a modest even transparent safety margin. Clean alpha cutout with no surrounding environment or rectangular plaque. Readable at 150 pixels.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background. NO text, letters, numerals, words, watermark, logo mockup, page background, full scene, faces, people, weapons, excessive filigree, muddy blur or large outer glow. Original artwork, not an imitation of any existing game logo.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original illustrated story-campaign logo emblem for the Home card of Guild of Wits, a medieval fantasy deduction game.
Primary request: design a distinctive self-contained emblem for “The Cursed Bell”, a story campaign with a prelude and four chapters. This title and description are context only; NO lettering in the image.
Subject: a single weathered antique-brass tavern bell, front three-quarter view, with a striking dark jagged crack through its body, suspended from a small carved walnut crossbar. A restrained cold blue spectral wisp curls through the crack and around the bell lip, suggesting a curse. Two spare thorn branches frame the bell loosely on either side. A short deep-blue cloth ribbon with restrained dotted silver medieval trim winds across the base; the ribbon is blank. Make the cracked bell the clear dominant silhouette.
Style: polished hand-painted fantasy game key art distilled into a strong recognizable campaign logo, tactile warm brass, carved wood, restrained magical light, crisp silhouette, generous large shapes, controlled detail. Sophisticated tabletop-guild identity, mysterious and inviting rather than horror. No character portraits.
Palette: antique gold and warm brass, walnut-brown shadows, deep heraldic blue #285371, a small pale icy-blue ghost-light accent. Distinctive on a dark walnut panel, related in materials to a parchment-and-four-formation-cards daily-quest emblem while having a wholly different bell silhouette.
Composition: one centered emblem, slightly wider than tall, all bell, branches and ribbon fully inside the image with a modest even transparent safety margin. Clean alpha cutout with no surrounding environment or rectangular plaque. Readable at 132 pixels high.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background. NO text, letters, numerals, words, watermark, logo mockup, page background, full scene, faces, people, zombies, skull piles, weapons, excessive filigree, muddy blur or large outer glow. Original artwork, not an imitation of any existing game logo.

packaging: Generated transparent PNG originals preserved unchanged. Runtime WebP images fit within 640×640, quality 90, alpha retained. No embedded text: titles and campaign descriptions remain live EN/PL HTML. Gameplay portraits are unchanged.
